title: Florida House, District 93
what_it_does: Represents District 93 (Part of Palm Beach) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.

candidates.name: Anne Gerwig
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Former Mayor of Wellington; CADD drafter for engineering and surveying firms; state representative since 2024
candidates.background: Anne Gerwig served two terms as mayor of Wellington after studying land surveying at Palm Beach State College and working as a CADD drafter for engineers and surveyors. She flipped District 93 in 2024 by 356 votes and in her first term passed a statewide Fentanyl Awareness Day and a school start-time flexibility bill while securing more than $4 million for district projects.

candidates.name: August Mangeney
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: August Mangeney, 43, is a first-generation college graduate who attended Union College in Kentucky on a football scholarship and earned his law degree from the University of Miami. He has practiced law for more than a decade, specializing in auto insurance, and has been a precinct committeeman and past president of the Margate Democratic Club. He lives in suburban Lake Worth with his wife, a former teacher, and two children.
